sn45.41:1.2: sace vo bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ puccheyyuṃ
sn45.41:1.3: kimatthiyaṃ āvuso samaṇe gotame brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti. evaṃ puṭṭhā tumhe bhikkhave tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ byākareyyātha
sn45.41:1.4: rāgavirāgatthaṃ kho āvuso bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ vussatīti.
sn45.41:1.5: sace pana vo bhikkhave aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evaṃ puccheyyuṃ
sn45.41:1.6: atthi panāvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā rāgavirāgāyāti. evaṃ puṭṭhā tumhe bhikkhave tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ byākareyyātha
sn45.41:1.7: atthi kho āvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā rāgavirāgāyāti.
sn45.41:1.8: katamo ca bhikkhave maggo katamā ca paṭipadā rāgavirāgāya.
sn45.41:1.11: ayaṃ bhikkhave maggo ayaṃ paṭipadā rāgavirāgāyāti.
sn45.41:1.12: evaṃ puṭṭhā tumhe bhikkhave tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ byākareyyāthāti.
